card.line: The Chebar was a river in the land of the Chaldeans where Jewish exiles lived, and where God gave Ezekiel his first visions and called him.

moments.title: Visions of God
moments.text: While Ezekiel was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and he saw visions of God. The word of the LORD came to him there, and the LORD's hand was upon him.

moments.title: Sitting with the exiles
moments.text: The Spirit brought Ezekiel to the exiles at Tel-abib by the River Kebar. He sat among them for seven days, overwhelmed. Then the LORD made him a watchman for Israel.

moments.title: Glory on the plain
moments.text: God told Ezekiel to go out to the plain. There the glory of the LORD was present, like the glory he had seen by the River Kebar, and Ezekiel fell facedown.

moments.title: Living creatures were cherubim
moments.text: In a later vision, the cherubim rose up with the glory of the LORD above them. Ezekiel said these were the living creatures he had seen by the River Kebar, and he knew they were cherubim.

moments.title: The glory returns
moments.text: Ezekiel saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. He said it was like the visions he had seen by the River Kebar, and he fell facedown. The glory of the LORD then entered the temple.
